reachability: Owner-only, one shot in practice because `igniteCauldron` (LaunchSniper.sol:70) can only succeed once. Every counterparty is a call argument, not stored state: `presale` (LaunchSniper.sol:59), `registry` (LaunchSniper.sol:60), `gachaRouter` (LaunchSniper.sol:61) and `airdropWallet` (LaunchSniper.sol:62) are all owner-supplied, so the only trust anchor is the owner. Ordering is ignite, then read the token, then buy, then forward — the forwarded amount is measured from this contract's balance at `balanceOf` (LaunchSniper.sol:79), not from the router's return value, so any token already sitting here is swept out with the purchase. Slippage protection is the caller's `minGnomeOut` (LaunchSniper.sol:63); no deadline is imposed. There is no reentrancy guard, but the only state is the ERC20 balance read at line 79.

The recipient is always the current `owner` (LaunchSniper.sol:88), so the destination rotates with ownership. The native leg is a raw `call` (LaunchSniper.sol:88) forwarding all gas and is required to succeed at `require` (LaunchSniper.sol:89); the token leg's boolean return is not checked.

Open ether sink with no bookkeeping; it exists so a router refund can land, per the note at `Recover` (LaunchSniper.sol:85). Anything received is recoverable only by the owner through `sweep` (LaunchSniper.sol:86), and while a `launch` (LaunchSniper.sol:58) is mid-flight any ether pushed here is NOT part of the forwarded amount, which is fixed to the message value at `play` (LaunchSniper.sol:76).
